Subject: Initial sync: ISO scope verification and timeline

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for taking time to speak earlier. We reviewed the draft scope you shared and have a couple of clarifying questions before we map evidence to controls:

- Can you confirm whether the on-prem backup appliances for customer VPCs are in-scope for ISO? We saw a note in the scope doc but not owners.
- For key management, do you have a single KMS provider or a split mode (Hosted KMS for hosted API, customer-managed for Private)? We need to identify control owners for CMK rotation evidence.
- Proposed audit window from our side: Jan 9-13, 2028. Would a pre-audit evidence drop of the control sampling work on Dec 20?

I've attached a redlined scope (ISO_Scope_Draft.pdf) and a starting evidence inventory we compiled from your shared spreadsheet. Please flag any incorrect assumptions.

Dawn

Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial sync: ISO scope verification and timeline

Dawn — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers and a few asks below.

- On-prem backup appliances: CONFIRMED in-scope for ISO; control owner is infra-ops (Marcus Lin). I'll include Marcus on the evidence mapping.
- KMS model: We operate a split model: Hosted API uses Redwood-managed KMS (AWS KMS with CMKs owned by Redwood), while Private/VPC deployments support customer-managed keys. Controls for key rotation evidence are split — I recommend we map them to two control families so sampling is clear.
- Timeline: Jan 9-13 works for the audit. Dec 20 pre-audit drop is tight for us given other end-of-year freezes; can we target Dec 28 instead? That gives us time to finalize service owner submissions after the evidence sprint.

I've attached an annotated evidence inventory (evidence_inventory_v2.xlsx) and a one-page runbook template (runbook_template.md) that outlines artifact packaging for sampled controls.

Action items I propose now: 
1) Internal owners confirm evidence by 2027-11-12 (infra-ops: Marcus; platform-sec: Kimberly).
2) Redwood to deliver initial evidence bundle for in-scope controls by 2027-12-28.
3) Schedule a joint pre-audit call week of 2027-12-29 to walk sampling and access.

Kimberly/Marcus — please confirm you can own steps 1 and 2, and flag any blockers.

Thanks,

Mina
Mina Haddad

Hi Mina,

Quick intro — I'm Luis from ThirdWave. We'll be the external audit team for Acme's ISO engagement. A couple logistical questions so we can draft the runbook: 

- Access model: will auditors get temporary SSO accounts scoped to read-only views, or do you provide a jumpbox with session recording? We need to document exact steps.
- Sampling approach: Acme wants to sample 8 controls with mixed cloud/on-prem footprint. Can you provide a prioritized list of 12 candidate controls by Nov 12 so we can agree on backup options?
- Evidence format: we prefer a single zipped bundle per control with a short manifest (runbook_template.md looks good). If you can produce prior-year examples for format guidance, that accelerates review.

We can do an hour call next Friday (Nov 12) 10:00-11:00 PT to finalize the candidate list and walk the runbook.

Regards,
Luis Navarro
Lead Auditor, ThirdWave Audits

Thanks Luis & Dawn — putting final proposal below and next steps so everyone has a single source of truth.

Proposed runbook & timeline (summary):
- Control candidate list: Redwood will prioritize 12 candidate controls and publish them in the shared Drive link by 2027-11-12. (Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cISOscope)
- Owner confirmations: Marcus (infra-ops) and Kimberly (platform-sec) to confirm evidence existence and point owners by 2027-11-12.
- Evidence packaging: Internal evidence sprint 2027-11-15 -> 2027-12-18. Evidence bundle (zipped per control with manifest) delivered 2027-12-28.
- Pre-audit walkthrough: 2027-12-29 10:00 PT — runbook and access tests.
- Audit execution: 2028-01-09 -> 2028-01-13.

Access model options (we recommend option A):
A) Temporary SSO accounts with read-only roles + IP-restricted session logging (preferred; minimal admin overhead).
B) Jumpbox with session recording and recorded export of sessions (useful for on-prem appliances where SSO not possible).

Extra notes / asks:
- Marcus: please provide owner for backup appliance evidence and confirm whether we can produce an encrypted VM snapshot or need a set of config + logs.
- Kimberly: can you export prior-year evidence formatting examples (sanitized) for ThirdWave? That will speed validation.

If there are no objections I'll: 1) upload the prioritized control list to the Drive by Fri 2027-11-12; 2) create a JIRA ticket SEC-4472 for tracker and link it to the runbook.

Best,
Mina
